relationship_to_gpu_request: GPU_REQUEST.json specifies the same surgical initial pair, native passes, returned tensors, controls, provenance and byte budget. This file states which missing observations prevent stronger conclusions; it does not ask for a second duplicate upload.
decision_blocked: Whether any nonidentity estimator can reduce genuine transient input excess while preserving real moderate local illumination and moving/new-view support in the actual native RR route. The returned diagnostic's bound application gain is identity; the provisional one-sided correction is not accepted for RR/NZR.
current_evidence_limits: Anchor arrays contain current scalar Stats, already-recalled keys, actual old gain and fixed masks. They do not contain independent physical illumination truth or raw six-slice key textures.

Native ratio metadata are bounded stored-FP16 estimates. Original pre-store full-dispatch16.16 low/high atomic sums were not exported; combined1/1024 counters are a different numerical/domain contract.
Native-policy shader grids were captured on an extracted harness. They are historical calibration, not this candidate's actual native bridge or fresh AMD RR execution.

Chronological bottle/foliage/facade crops omit albedo and pre-start history; moving crop origins must be respected. Their raw/selected RR outputs are not converged truth and cannot be reused as output for a newly modified input.
Colour's single stored GPU frame follows CPU history warmup; glass is aligned raw/old-NZR output. Neither supplies the missing native illumination cause witness.

requests.missing_observation: An independently established expected physical D/S response at the same target pose before and after a genuine moderate engine-light intervention, and at constant-light motion stop, with spatially resolved uncertainty and validity.
requests.why_current_data_cannot_identify_it: True light1.25 and input excess1.25 can produce byte-identical current/recalled grids, masks and motion metadata. A ratio threshold, decay prior, MAD or repeated current frame cannot identify which world occurred. Sparse high-energy tails may be true reflection structure; deleting them is not proof of denoising.

hypotheses_distinguished.hypothesis: captured early excess is mostly transient estimator noise/bias
hypotheses_distinguished.independent_prediction: At matched camera/geometry/light state, the independent physical reference remains near the constant-light level while current native D/S has an early excess larger than reference uncertainty.

hypotheses_distinguished.hypothesis: observed current/reference change contains genuine illumination
hypotheses_distinguished.independent_prediction: The independent physical reference changes with the real engine intervention; a correction suppressing that supported change incurs measurable light-response loss.

hypotheses_distinguished.hypothesis: apparent difference is geometry/disocclusion/support rather than level bias
hypotheses_distinguished.independent_prediction: Reference validity or baseline support changes account for the affected region; when those are held fixed the proposed level effect does not persist.

smallest_useful_initial_experiment.pair: Matched actual camera trajectory ending at the same target pose at relative0; one run keeps engine light constant, the other changes a documented real light parameter to nominal1.25 at0 and holds it through31. Record the realized D/S ratio rather than assuming nominal parameter value equals every pixel's radiance ratio.
smallest_useful_initial_experiment.same_pose_and_motion_extension: After the first pair, locally test real1.1/1.25/1.4 steps in both directions at the same pose and during active motion, then a moving object against a static background whose light changes. Upload summaries and the first new discriminating counterexample, not every full capture.
smallest_useful_initial_experiment.original_frame_ordinals_reason: New scene events have not been recorded; return exact original frameIndex/ordinal/onset mapping, never fabricated identifiers.
smallest_useful_initial_experiment.prehistory_available_reason: Actual complete local history is unknown. Keep all real context-start-to-window inputs locally and disclose unavailable history; do not manufacture it by replaying a short window repeatedly.

exact_requested_tensors_and_metadata.native_current_inputs: Original pre-Anchor/pre-provider-scale diffuse and specular RGBA16F, depthR32F, original full-render-UV motionRGBA16F, original/prepared packed guides;40 chronological192x192 crops per source, roles/strides/frame IDs as GPU_REQUEST.json.
exact_requested_tensors_and_metadata.required_metadata: Actual light-control events, engine state/camera/geometry/time identity, exposure/remod settings, reference generation method, random-seed/independence provenance, uncertainty method/coverage target, per-lobe count treatment under correlation, hashes and missing support. The reference must share the native physical lobe domain; final displayed RGB or selected RR is insufficient.

units.radiance: native physical pre-provider-scale lobe RGB units; no multiply256 and no final-game remod substitution
units.physical_SI_unit_reason: The capture contract supplies pipeline physical units, not an independently calibrated SI radiometric unit.
units.reference_bounds: same units as each corresponding D/S RGB channel; state actual statistical coverage/assumptions
units.motion: original previous-minus-current full-render UV, B linear depth delta
units.alpha: original input hit-distance bytes retained; not estimated by RGB reference

extent_and_crop.unknown_reason: Select the core from unmodified BASE before evaluating variants, inside the actual new scene render, aligned to8. Return original extents and every crop origin. Retain outside-crop native/RR execution locally.

requests.proposed_local_extraction: If the engine exposes a legitimate same-pose high-sample mode or independent-seed renderer, hold the documented scene state and estimate physical D/S means plus defensible bounds. Keep raw independent replicates locally with hashes and upload summaries only. The actual engine API/control is unknown: if unavailable, report that this observation cannot be obtained. Scaling saved tensors, treating a late input frame as truth, or looping a noisy frame does not satisfy this request.
requests.production_affordability: This observation may require offline research effort and may be impractical in the live pipeline. It can validate or reject the proposed explanation without implying an affordable production witness.
requests.maximum_useful_payload: The three reference summaries plus the shared cropped pair specified in GPU_REQUEST.json, within the common256MiB uncompressed cap. Reference raw replicates and full scene histories remain local.
competing_outcomes_and_next_decision: Reference stable, input transient excess exceeds uncertainty on fixed support: continue a new explicitly conditioned estimator hypothesis; current candidate is not automatically accepted.
Reference follows the observed moderate change: reject correction that removes it; the indistinguishability warning is realized by an actual light intervention.
Spatially mixed true light/noise/support: require a per-region independent-observation contract or retain abstention; a single scalar witness is inadequate.
Reference uncertainty overlaps both causes or no reference capability exists: keep diagnostic identity and research status; do not convert missing evidence into a causal confidence score.

requests.missing_observation: The original native full-dispatch32-byte frame-sums buffer after Stats and before Gain, together with exact dispatch/support scope and constant bytes.
requests.why_current_data_cannot_identify_it: FP16 stored fields lose pre-store bits, while the native atomics quantize original physical values at16.16. An exported midpoint can straddle a strict rejection boundary. Cropped FP16 cells also cannot reconstruct the actual full-frame denominator. Exact combined1/1024 counters are not the native16.16 sums.
hypotheses_distinguished: Apparent acceptance/rejection is stable under true native arithmetic.
A claimed branch or ratio depends on guessing missing pre-store bits or replacing full-frame support with a cropped denominator.
requests.capture_stage: FSRDNrdPostMotionAnchorStatsRecall OutSums after all InterlockedAdd writes and the required UAV ordering barrier, before FSRDNrdPostMotionAnchorGain consumes it

sums.format: eight little-endian uint32 words /32 exact bytes

exact_requested_tensors_and_metadata.constants: Original Stats864-byte, Gain80-byte and Apply16-byte buffers; preserve all floating bit patterns and native host state flags.
exact_requested_tensors_and_metadata.scope_metadata: Actual full dispatch grid and render/allocation extent, original valid/static count, source frame ordinal/index, reset/active/refresh, full-grid fixed-mask hash and local full-grid bound summary. Crop Stats/Recalled with global cell origin remain separately identified.
exact_requested_tensors_and_metadata.inactive_frame_rule: If the pass did not execute on a frame, mark the result unavailable instead of exporting stale or synthetic zero counters as an observation.

requests.units: physical cap16, floor-to16.16 scale65536, emulated uint64 sums. No physical input rescaling, ABI widening or composite/per-lobe domain substitution.
requests.extent: global native sums cover actual full dispatch; accompanying192x192/24x24 export covers only the named fixed crop
requests.actual_gpu_row_pitch_reason: Buffer is32 bytes; texture readback pitches for accompanying fields are device/resource observations and must be recorded rather than guessed.
requests.proposed_local_extraction: In the job08-owned local diagnostic instrumentation, copy the unchanged32-byte UAV to a per-frame readback allocation with correct barriers and fence ownership, restore required state and tag it with the exact frame. Compute integer ratios and the shader's split-word FP32 ratio separately. Locally compare full-grid quantization bounds against the exact buffer; do not claim the uploaded crop sums reproduce global atomics.
requests.maximum_useful_payload: These160 original sum buffers and corresponding constant bytes fit inside the shared initial upload. No raw ring textures or full-resolution capture is requested for this numerical question.
competing_outcomes_and_next_decision: Exact native ratio lies within declared bounds and strict decisions agree: conditional arithmetic model is supported for those observations, not exactness of all stored-field estimates.
Exact ratio or guard lies outside claimed bounds: reject/fix the numerical model with job01; do not loosen a quality threshold or hide the failing frame.
Buffer or full-frame scope unavailable: retain interval uncertainty and abstention; never substitute the central stored estimate as exact.

requests.missing_observation: Execution of the actual native Config/owned-resource/Stats/Gain/Apply/provider path for the identity diagnostic, with a discriminating legacy native canary and fresh AMD RR output.
requests.why_current_data_cannot_identify_it: Historical extracted-host CSOs, CPU arithmetic and a source-shaped adapter cannot prove current native resource selection, scheduling, fence lifetime, physical input scale, alpha preservation or provider consumption. Stored RR output cannot respond to a new input correction.
hypotheses_distinguished: The diagnostic is correctly reached while the provider receives unchanged physical D/S identity copies.
The option is bypassed, stale resources are consumed, original/private domains are confused, or provisional nonidentity gain accidentally reaches the provider.
requests.capture_stage: RRWrapper::Configure -> RecordOwned/NativePostMotionAnchor::Prepare/RecordInputs -> actual provider dispatch -> CommitOwned; witness sourceInput, private post-Apply physical copies, pre-scale binding IDs and restored physical resources

exact_requested_tensors_and_metadata.post_apply_snapshots: Physical D/S RGBA16F192x192 at relative[-1,0,8,24,31], two source sequences and two enabled variants; all other frames carry per-stage bit hashes/energy/alpha witnesses.
exact_requested_tensors_and_metadata.fresh_rr_outputs: Fresh native raw D/S RGBA16F128x128 core for every relative frame-8..31 and all three variants, plus actual provider attestation/reset/order metadata.
exact_requested_tensors_and_metadata.canary: Actual known-active legacy nonidentity case; forced-OFF mutation must fail the expected correction/routing assertion. The identity diagnostic is validated separately; provisional gain remains an unbound output.
exact_requested_tensors_and_metadata.readback_formats_and_strides: See GPU_REQUEST.json; record actual source allocation/render dimensions and GPU row pitches, export tight arrays with preserved words.

requests.units: Physical native D/S before providerD16/S256 scaling, alpha untouched; original G3 inputs remain unchanged; RR/NZR consume owned copies in their intended domain.
requests.unknown_fields_reason: The fresh local scene, history availability, native integration revision and hardware have not been observed here. Return them explicitly; do not fill from a different historical capture.
requests.proposed_local_extraction: Job08 implements the reviewed diagnostic adapter separately, compiles fresh proposed DXC1.8 cs_6_2 CSMain -O3 -HV2021 bytecode, and runs native-owned execution with D3D debug/lifetime checks. Retain full inputs and albedo locally for RR replay. Use complete unlooped histories once per fresh provider context; report OFF-vs-OFF repeatability before claiming pixel parity.
requests.provisional_restriction: Do not feed provisional_gain to RR/NZR under this request. A nonidentity future adapter needs a separate local acceptance and independent-observable contract.
requests.maximum_useful_payload: The defined snapshots, core outputs, diagnostics and metadata inside the shared256MiB cap. Full captures, all ring slices and repeated reference samples remain local.
competing_outcomes_and_next_decision: Native canary rejects forced-OFF and identity physical/alpha outputs match: diagnostic wiring is supported, with no denoising-quality claim.
Canary cannot distinguish OFF, copies/scales/alpha differ, or provisional gain reaches Apply: reject integration and fix the specific local path before any image-quality comparison.
Fresh identity RR differs from OFF beyond actual measured provider repeatability: investigate history/resource/provider effects; do not attribute a quality improvement to an identity estimator.
Native/provider execution unavailable: retain CPU-only scope and proposed adapter status.

Source/integration commits, configuration, source/HLSL/CSO/header/compiler hashes, device/driver/provider identities, actual executor and local commands.
Exact roles, formats, units, render/allocation extents, per-frame crop origins and source GPU strides; original FP16 alpha bytes.
SHA256 of raw exported arrays, source capture manifest, fixed BASE masks/denominators, original32-byte sums and every result; no manifest self-hash.
Independent light-reference generation and uncertainty provenance; distinguish a real engine intervention from synthetic multiplication of captured tensors.
Declare missing history/support/reference pixels and unavailable observations explicitly; no looping/clamping/future-frame reference or candidate-dependent mask replacement.

size_budget.scope: one shared initial paired experiment, not one upload per request

Run expanded controls locally and upload small summaries or the first discriminating failure only. If an input/reference cannot be produced, return the exact unavailable observation rather than a larger unrelated capture.
